record.question: He said he __________ always come when called.
record.explanation: Answer C: could. “Could” is the backshifted form of “can” after “He said”. Independent check: In reported speech after “He said,” “could” backshifts “can” in the habitual possibility statement. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/reported-speech. Verified worked solution, unofficial.
